title: Lighting Assessment
description: Free Lighting Assessment template you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers illuminance measurements, quality of lighting, actions.

Quality Of Lighting

☐ No glare from luminaires, windows or shiny surfaces

☐ No flicker or stroboscopic effect on moving machinery

☐ No harsh shadows on the task

☐ Colour rendering suitable where colours must be distinguished

☐ Fittings clean, no failed lamps

☐ Emergency and exit lighting tested and recorded

☐ Workers do not report eye strain or headaches

Note

1. Recommended levels are typical values (see EN 12464-1 or local standard). Use the level

required by your local regulation or standard where it differs.
